# Draft:Dr. Bhubaneswar Borooah Cancer Institute - BBCI

The Dr. Bhubaneswar Borooah Cancer Institute is a cancer care hospital and research institute located in Guwahati, Assam, India.
History
The institute was established in 1973 and is named after Dr. Bhubaneswar Borooah, a renowned physician and freedom fighter from Assam.
About
The Dr. Bhubaneswar Borooah Cancer Institute is a regional cancer center that provides comprehensive cancer care, including diagnosis, treatment, and rehabilitation. The institute has state-of-the-art facilities, including radiation therapy, chemotherapy, and surgical oncology.
Departments
Medical Oncology Department: Provides treatment and management of cancer using chemotherapy, immunotherapy, and hormone therapy.
Radiation Oncology Department: Offers radiation therapy services, including external beam radiation therapy, brachytherapy, and stereotactic body radiation therapy.
Surgical Oncology Department: Performs surgical procedures for cancer diagnosis, staging, and treatment.
Nuclear Medicine Department: Provides diagnostic and therapeutic services using radioactive isotopes.
Pathology Department: Offers diagnostic services, including histopathology, cytopathology, and molecular pathology.
Research Department: Conducts research in cancer biology, epidemiology, and clinical research.
Palliative Care Department: Provides symptom management, pain relief, and supportive care to patients with advanced cancer.
Radiology Department: Offers imaging services, including X-ray, ultrasound, CT scan, MRI, and mammography.
Blood Bank Department: Provides blood and blood components for patients undergoing cancer treatment.
Pharmacy Department: Dispenses medications and provides counseling on medication use.
Dietary Department: Offers nutrition counseling and dietary advice to patients with cancer.
IT Department: Responsible for managing the institute's information technology infrastructure, including hardware, software, and networking systems. The IT department also provides technical support and maintains the institute's website and other digital platforms.
Clinical Departments
1. Medical Oncology Department
Provides treatment and management of cancer using chemotherapy, immunotherapy, and hormone therapy
Offers services for various types of cancer, including breast cancer, lung cancer, gastrointestinal cancer, and more
Conducts clinical trials for new cancer treatments
2. Radiation Oncology Department
Offers radiation therapy services, including external beam radiation therapy, brachytherapy, and stereotactic body radiation therapy
Treats various types of cancer, including head and neck cancer, breast cancer, lung cancer, and more
Uses advanced radiation therapy techniques, such as IMRT, IGRT, and SBRT
3. Surgical Oncology Department
Performs surgical procedures for cancer diagnosis, staging, and treatment
Offers services for various types of cancer, including breast cancer, lung cancer, gastrointestinal cancer, and more
Conducts minimally invasive surgical procedures, such as laparoscopic and robotic surgery
4. Nuclear Medicine Department
Provides diagnostic and therapeutic services using radioactive isotopes
Offers services for cancer diagnosis, staging, and treatment monitoring
Conducts procedures, such as PET-CT scans and radioactive iodine therapy
5. Palliative Care Department
Provides symptom management, pain relief, and supportive care to patients with advanced cancer
Offers services to improve quality of life for patients and their families
Conducts counseling and support services for patients and their caregivers
6. Pediatric Oncology Department
Provides treatment and management of cancer in children
Offers services for various types of childhood cancer, including leukemia, lymphoma, and solid tumors
Conducts clinical trials for new childhood cancer treatments
7. Gynecological Oncology Department
Provides treatment and management of gynecological cancers, including cervical cancer, ovarian cancer, and endometrial cancer
Offers services for cancer diagnosis, staging, and treatment
Conducts surgical procedures, such as radical hysterectomy and ovarian cancer debulking
8. Urological Oncology Department
Provides treatment and management of urological cancers, including prostate cancer, bladder cancer, and kidney cancer
Offers services for cancer diagnosis, staging, and treatment
Conducts surgical procedures, such as radical prostatectomy and cystectomy
9. Neuro-Oncology Department
Provides treatment and management of brain and spinal cord tumors
Offers services for cancer diagnosis, staging, and treatment
Conducts surgical procedures, such as craniotomy and spinal surgery, and provides radiation therapy and chemotherapy services
Non-Clinical Departments
1. IT Department
Responsible for managing the institute's information technology infrastructure, including hardware, software, and networking systems
Provides technical support and maintains the institute's website and other digital platforms
Ensures data security and confidentiality
2. Administration Department
Oversees the overall administration of the institute
Manages human resources, finance, and other support services
Ensures compliance with regulatory requirements and institutional policies
3. Finance Department
Manages the financial transactions of the institute
Prepares and monitors budgets, financial reports, and statements
Ensures financial compliance and transparency
4. Human Resources Department
Manages the recruitment, training, and development of staff
Oversees employee relations, benefits, and welfare programs
Ensures compliance with labor laws and regulations
5. Maintenance Department
Responsible for the maintenance and upkeep of the institute's infrastructure, including buildings, equipment, and utilities
Ensures a safe and healthy environment for patients, staff, and visitors
6. Civil Department
Responsible for the planning, design, and construction of new buildings and infrastructure
Oversees repairs and renovations of existing buildings and infrastructure
Ensures compliance with building codes and regulations
7. Laundry and Linen Department
Provides laundry and linen services to the institute
Ensures a steady supply of clean linen and uniforms
8. Dietary Department
Provides food and nutrition services to patients and staff
Ensures a safe and healthy food environment
9. Security Department
Ensures the safety and security of patients, staff, and visitors
Manages access control, surveillance, and emergency response systems
Research and Academics
The institute is involved in various research activities, including clinical trials, epidemiological studies, and basic research. It also offers various academic programs, including MD, MS, and diploma courses in oncology.
Services
Cancer diagnosis and treatment
Cancer screening and early detection
Palliative care
Rehabilitation services
References
Dr. Bhubaneswar Borooah Cancer Institute (BBCI) is a prominent cancer care center located in Guwahati, Assam, India. Established in 1973, it has been recognized as a Regional Cancer Centre by the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India, since 1980. [http://Uicc.org uicc.org]
External References and Collaborations:
* Union for International Cancer Control (UICC): BBCI is an associate member of the UICC, reflecting its commitment to global cancer control initiatives. [http://Uicc.org uicc.org]
* Jiv Daya Foundation: The institute has been featured by the Jiv Daya Foundation, highlighting its dedication to providing high-quality cancer treatment with modern healthcare technology. [https://www.Jivdayafound.org jivdayafound.org]
Key Personnel:
* Dr. Bibhuti Bhusan Borthakur: Serving as the Director of BBCI since January 1, 2023, Dr. Borthakur brings over 30 years of experience in surgical oncology and has contributed significantly to cancer care and research. [https://www.bbcionline.org/ bbcionline.org]
* Dr. Mouchumee Bhattacharyya: As the Deputy Director (Research) and Professor of Radiation Oncology, Dr. Bhattacharyya possesses over 23 years of experience in radiotherapy and plays a pivotal role in advancing the institute's research initiatives. [https://www.bbcionline.org/ bbcionline.org]
Research and Academic Contributions:
BBCI is actively involved in various research projects, including studies on predictive biomarkers for metastasis in head and neck cancer patients. The institute also houses a Clinical Research Secretariat (CRS) that supports retrospective and prospective studies, underscoring its commitment to advancing cancer research.
